what: One am dumpheap (no -g) of p13g.apk 35 s into the /stats phase of a lobby load run (tools/perf-p13g-lobby-ab.py --phases quiet,stats --dump-at 100), read by tools/perf-p13f-heap.py. Every unreachable array of 12 KiB or more (ART large-object threshold), grouped. The dump stalled the app past the load script's 5 s timeout, so that run has no rates.
note: No reply String, no UTF-8 copy, no {"audio": builder and no double[4096]: none of P13f's /stats arrays remain. Left: ktor CIO's char[8192] header buffers (16,384 B, one per request header line read; not app code) and two 12,325 B Career.json byte[] built by the game's publish.
